correctness.rationale: The source PMF is a telescoping survival discretization, so \(\Pr(Y\ge k)=\Lambda_\mu(k)\) exactly. The integer tail-sum identity then gives every raw moment. Closed-form geometric-series evaluation yields the stated mean and second moment, and direct PMF summation agrees with them. The PGF follows from the same tail identity and has its nearest pole at \(s=e^\mu\), so the MGF exists exactly for \(t<\mu\).
